hooks.logic:
Count up "turnInCurrentMode".
If condition flag "ability_close_done" is up this frame, then choose state 13 next and stop.
Let ability be the id of the move labelled "demons_claw_1" on the enemy.
Let ability2 be the id of the move labelled "demons_claw_2" on the enemy.
Any item in the results "buddy_result_object" this frame passes given (x) { Let v5 be call helper6 with (x). If v5 is ability or v5 is ability2, then { Set the register's 'lastDemonsClawTargetBuddyNo' to the value "no" of x's 'receiver'. Return true. } }.
Let v be run helper2.
If the current form of the enemy is not v's 'paramSuffixNoOpen', then
  The enemy changes to form v's 'paramSuffixNoOpen'.
  The enemy cancels its cast.
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  Let v2 be the count "turnInCurrentMode".
  Let v3 be helper5 → call with (this state, list2, v2).
  Let data be {}.
  If v3 is the id of the move labelled "demons_claw_1" on the enemy or v3 is the id of the move labelled "demons_claw_2" on the enemy, then
    Let v4 be call helper4 with (the register's 'lastDemonsClawTargetBuddyNo').
    If v4 is missing, then run helper7 on "01" and stop.
    Set data to {forceTargets: [v4]}.
  The enemy uses v3 with options data.

script_hooks.logic:
Given arg1, arg2.
Set arg2 to _ → extend with ({}, arg2).
Let v be the items member in the living party where not not member → is-possible-to-target and (not arg2's 'row' or call game:util.ActorConditionMatcher.match with (member, {row: arg2's 'row'})).
If not (the length of v is at most 0), then
  Let v2 be _ → sort-by with (v, given (x) { Return the value "no" of x. }).
  Let v3 be the first x in v2 where the value "no" of x is more than arg1.
  If not v3, then set v3 to _ → first with (v2).
  Return v3.

Return v or a smart-weighted move of the enemy.
